criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Study, site and country data model; named integrations with the eTMF, EDC and SAP finance systems; reporting dashboards; multi-country configuration; scalability to 40+ concurrent studies.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Migration waves and milestones; legacy data migration strategy; computer system validation (CSV) phases; user training; hypercare; risk register; realism of the 12-month timeline.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Licence model (per study or per user); implementation fee; validation services fee; five-year total cost of ownership; clarity and completeness of pricing assumptions.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and electronic signatures; GxP validation package (IQ/OQ/PQ); GDPR and data residency; ISO 27001 or SOC 2; HIPAA; access control and auditability.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Support model and SLA tiers; 24/7 coverage; hypercare duration; named pharma or CRO references; number of CTMS go-lives; regulatory inspection history.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: Most technical capabilities are addressed with specific details, including named integrations and reporting features, but the scalability aspect could be more explicitly detailed.
criteria.evidence: NexaCTMS provides study, country, site, subject and visit management... Integrations... eTMF: standard REST connector... EDC: standard connector... SAP: payment requests are transmitted via a standard file interface...

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan is comprehensive, detailing migration waves, milestones, and a clear strategy for legacy data migration and user training.
criteria.evidence: We propose four waves across 12 months... Legacy data is migrated by study cohort with automated reconciliation reports.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The proposal provides a clear breakdown of costs and pricing assumptions, but could benefit from more detail on the five-year total cost of ownership.
criteria.evidence: Licence is a platform fee covering up to 50 active studies and unlimited users... Total $3,200,000.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: All security and compliance requirements are thoroughly addressed with specific certifications and compliance measures.
criteria.evidence: 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant audit trail and electronic signatures... ISO 27001:2022 certified... GDPR: hosting available in the EU or US.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The support model is well-defined with specific SLAs and hypercare duration, but could include more named references for added credibility.
criteria.evidence: Support (Gold tier included)... Eight weeks of hypercare after each scale wave with a named customer success manager.

risks: Potential gaps in scalability details may affect future growth.
Assumptions regarding the sponsor's SAP team could lead to integration delays.
suppliers.overall_summary: NexaWorks presents a strong proposal for a cloud-based CTMS with a detailed implementation plan and robust security measures. While most criteria are well addressed, minor gaps in scalability and reference details could be improved.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The proposal addresses most technical capabilities with specific details on integrations and reporting, but lacks explicit mention of scalability to 40+ concurrent studies.
criteria.evidence: ApexTrial is a multi-tenant SaaS CTMS with a hierarchical data model of Program, Study, Country, Site and Subject.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan is detailed with migration waves and milestones, but the timeline exceeds the sponsor's request by two months, which is a minor gap.
criteria.evidence: We propose a three-wave migration over 14 months.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The proposal provides a clear licensing model and detailed pricing assumptions, but the implementation fee could be more explicitly broken down.
criteria.evidence: Licence is per active study per year, which scales with the sponsor's portfolio rather than headcount.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: All security and compliance requirements are thoroughly addressed with specific details on regulations and certifications.
criteria.evidence: ISO 27001:2022 certified (fictional certificate AX-27001-2024-118) and SOC 2 Type II report issued annually.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The support model is well-defined with specific SLAs and named references, but could benefit from more detail on the number of CTMS go-lives.
criteria.evidence: Hypercare of 10 weeks after each wave with a named support lead on site two days per week.

risks: The proposed timeline exceeds the sponsor's 12-month target by two months, which may impact project urgency.
Potential data quality issues during legacy data migration could pose risks to the project.
Dependency on sponsor's timely provision of API credentials and SAP development client could delay implementation.
suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems presents a strong proposal for a validated cloud-based CTMS with comprehensive technical capabilities and compliance measures. While there are minor gaps in the implementation timeline and detail, the overall fit for the sponsor's needs is promising.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: Most technical capabilities are addressed, including integrations and reporting, but specific details on scalability and multi-country configuration are lacking.
criteria.evidence: OrbitTrials provides comprehensive study, site, subject, monitoring and payment management with configurable workflows.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan outlines migration waves and milestones clearly, but the timeline is slightly longer than the requested 12 months.
criteria.evidence: We propose two waves over 13 months.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The proposal provides a detailed breakdown of costs and pricing assumptions, with only minor details missing.
criteria.evidence: Licence is per active study per year.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: The proposal addresses key compliance requirements and security measures, but lacks specific details on HIPAA compliance.
criteria.evidence: OrbitTrials has supported regulated clinical operations for ten years and is built to meet applicable regulatory requirements including 21 CFR Part 11.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The support model is well-defined with 24/7 coverage and hypercare, but lacks specific details on the number of CTMS go-lives.
criteria.evidence: 24x7 support for P1 incidents with a one-hour response target.

risks: Integration complexity - mitigated by our standard connector library and prior experience.
Sponsor data readiness - mitigated by our proven migration templates.
suppliers.overall_summary: Orbit Digital presents a strong proposal for a cloud-based CTMS with a solid implementation plan and comprehensive support. While there are minor gaps in specific details, the overall offering aligns well with the sponsor's requirements.
suppliers.tie_break_reason: Rule 1 (PPI): Apex Systems 96.00 vs Orbit Digital 90.67

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The proposal mentions integrations with major eTMF, EDC, and ERP systems but lacks specific names and details about the data model and scalability for 40+ studies.
criteria.evidence: BrightTrial integrates with all major eTMF, EDC and ERP systems through our flexible integration layer.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan outlines a timeline and phases but lacks detail on the legacy data migration strategy and risk register.
criteria.evidence: We propose a single go-live (big-bang) approach over seven months.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The pricing model is clear and detailed, but the validation services fee is mentioned as excluded, which is a minor gap.
criteria.evidence: Licence is per named user per year.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: The proposal addresses several compliance aspects but lacks specific details on GxP validation and ISO 27001 certification.
criteria.evidence: The platform is designed with regulatory requirements in mind.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The support model is described but lacks detail on SLA tiers and the number of CTMS go-lives.
criteria.evidence: Support is provided by email and web portal during business hours.

risks: The main risk is sponsor availability for workshops and UAT.
suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech offers a cloud-based CTMS with a clear implementation plan and pricing structure. However, the proposal lacks some specific details required for a comprehensive evaluation, particularly in technical capability and compliance.
